tools.name: compare_communities
tools.description:
Compare up to eight community names. Returns observed count ranges and the percentage of
communities with fewer threads found. Public sample rows also include exact counts.
Accepts names with or without r/. Results follow input order and are case-insensitive.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description:
Return the observation methodology, field definitions, exact sample size, distribution
of all communities by observed threads found, and URLs for the sample and dataset page.

tools.name: describe_threadcraft_bundle
tools.description: Show the contents and purchase options when a user asks about the full ThreadCraft product.

tools.name: get_research_offers
tools.description:
Get current USD prices, availability, license terms, card checkout and free sample links.
Use for price or purchase questions. Creates no order.

tools.name: prepare_research_bitcoin_invoice
tools.description:
Create or retrieve a private on-chain Bitcoin invoice after the buyer requests checkout for
a specific research edition. This reserves a quote and never sends funds. Reuse the same
edition and key to check payment and get paid downloads. Keep the key and receipt private.
